summary.headline: Antiochus’s Astrological Treasuries
summary.text: Catalog of Florentine codex astrological materials, including Julian on inceptions, Leo the Philosopher’s scholia on the horimaia, Valens on the twelve places, and Photius’s scholion. A numbered survey from the treasuries of Antiochus covers signs, stars, sect, exaltations and depressions, trigon lords, decans, fixed stars, terms, aspects, dodecatemoria, rays, spear-bearing, and related astrological doctrines.
